reviews.feedback: 1) internal/store/types.go:248-252: PreviousSecret and PreviousSecretExpiresAt are tagged json:"-", but cmd/tally/main.go loads and saves the state via internal/snapshot (snapshot.go:30, state.go:64/175). After a restart within 24h of a rotation the previous secret is dropped, so deliveries carry one v1 entry instead of two, violating the 24-hour overlap requirement. Persist the overlap state in the snapshot (e.g. a snapshot-only field or struct in store/state.go with previous_secret and previous_secret_expires_at, restored in the import path) without exposing PreviousSecret through the API JSON. Add a test that rotates an endpoint, round-trips through Export/FromState or snapshot Save/Load, and checks that the overlap still signs deliveries.
